caption:
Netball or basketball on the calendar? Momo's landings get wobbly late in the game, and she's not alone.

Court sports are full of jumps, stops and sharp changes of direction. Your ankles, knees and hips soak up that load, so control on one leg matters as much as fitness.

Clinical Pilates lets you practise single-leg squats, lunges and jump-board work with adjustable springs, building control before speed. Pre-season, two sessions a week is a common start; in season, one often keeps things ticking over.

Our Pilates team at Hybrid Physio can help. Book online via the link in bio
